changes.comment: sdk-ui-charts: Do not draw data labels that cannot be displayed on column, bar and waterfall charts with 'auto' data label visibility. Highcharts drew a label for every data point, each one forcing a style recalculation, before the auto-hide rules hid all of them again - which blocked the main thread for seconds on charts with many data points. A 1794-point column chart now renders in 0.2s instead of 6.9s.
